safetyGuidance: Do NOT immediately uninstall or confront an abuser if you fear for your physical safety; removing stalkerware can alert the installer.
Use a different, trusted device to seek help, change passwords, and review account recovery options.
Document evidence (screenshots of the detected app name, permissions, and install date) safely.
Enable 2-Step Verification on your Google, email, and banking accounts from a safe device.
In India, call National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 or Women Helpline 181 for confidential assistance.
